identification: Box of about 15 vintage books and a map. Titles read from spines: Anatomy of Britain (Anthony Sampson, Hodder), The Countryman's England (Dorothy Hartley), The Dog Crusoe (Ballantyne), A Pattern of Islands (Arthur Grimble), The Rainbow and the Rose (Nevil Shute), The British Countryside (Leutscher), a Walt Disney Peter Pan and Wendy book, Discovering Poetry, and two large red cloth volumes. Also Philips' Motor Road Map of the British Isles, red cloth cover, folding linen-backed map (c.1900s-1930s).

viewing_check: Estimate $20-30, current bid $10. Pull the green gilt-spined Banfield 'Confessions of a Beachcomber' from the middle of the box first: title page date 1908 and T. Fisher Unwin, London, with no 'impression' line on the verso, top edge gilt and plates present. If it is the 1908 first in fair shape, the lot is worth bidding A$80-120 hammer (about A$100-145 with 22% premium). Then check the Shute copyright page for 'First published 1958' with no reprint, and the Grimble for a 1952 first impression. Open the map to see if it is cloth-backed. Read the unread maroon embossed book, the orange bird-cover book, the navy photo book and the thin buff spines, since the photos can't resolve them.
